steps.content: The flame kindles the liquid darkness and the fire rages on rapidly. The monster flips and turns in the fire, dwindling.
Eventually, its massive body burns out completely and vanishes, leaving only a faint burned smell in the air.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Phew...
You let out a long sigh. After countless challenges, you finally defeated the monster you once thought invincible.
You come next to the girl, patting her on the shoulder.
But she just stands there silently for a long time.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What's wrong? Are you still scared...
Before you can finish, Hestia suddenly speaks up.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: We...

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Won?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yeah, we won beautifully. If only you could see it. The monster turned into a big firework at the end. Whoosh, and it vanished in the fire...

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Has it really... disappeared?
Tears swirl in the girl's eyes. Her body is so weak she can barely stand. Even the torch she never parts with falls aside.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why are you crying? We won...
The moment you touch her, the girl dives into your arms and bursts into tears.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: (Crying loudly)

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: What kind of plan was that? I really thought I was going to die! Idiot! You stupid, arrogant little punk! I'm never listening to you again!!
Her cotton-light punches bounce off you. You can no longer hold back your laugh.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Don't laugh!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We're still alive. Two kids have beaten the big monster and uncovered the truth behind this darkness. We don't have to be afraid anymore!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let's go, Hestia! Back to the expedition! We'll tell everyone that both of their little guides are super amazing! Everyone will be proud of you!
Hestia grabs your hand and musters all her strength to get up, but her legs give out and she sits back down on the ground, her face turning beet red.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: My legs... have given out. I can't walk...
Hearing you laugh again, she starts poking you with her torch angrily. You laugh so hard you're bending over and letting her jab you repeatedly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Alright, alright, my bad. Want me to carry you?

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Like you can, you runt. I'm taller than you... Woah!!
You laugh as you lift her up. Hestia wraps her arms around your neck, screaming in surprise and indignation by your ear, but her crackling little sparks reveal her joy.
The flicking glimmer can't pierce through the distant night, but is still enough to briefly illuminate a short stretch of your journey together.
